transcript.text: Let's understand AI buzzwords. MCP or
Model Context Protocol is a standardized
protocol that lets AI models securely
connect to external tools and services
like GitHub, Slack, Notion, databases,
APIs, and lot more without custom
integrations. RAG or Retrieval Augmented
Generation is a way to give AI access to
your own documents and data, so it
answers questions based on your
information rather than just using the
data that it has been trained on.
Context window is the maximum amount of
information an AI model can process and
remember one time during a conversation,
which also includes prompts,
conversation history, and retrieve
files. Multimodal AI, so AI system that
can understand and generate multiple
types of data including text, video,
audio, PDFs, and structured document in
a single workflow. Comment below AI for
part two. Subscribe.
